title: WebGL 3D Install Spec (engine #3) — STUB
description: STUB schema for the WebGL 3D install engine (engine #3, 'The Forge'; R3F/Three.js; mounting/wiring/egress installs). Built in M5 ON the F5 framework — Rapier physics deferred from MVP. This stub fixes ONLY the shared envelope + the engine_kind so consumers and the 2D picture-book fallback can target it now; the 3D scene/asset/interaction model is EXPANDED in F5/M5. engine_kind is pinned to 'webgl_install' (academy.sim_kind). DO NOT author production 3D specs against this stub — it intentionally under-specifies the scene.

envelope.description: Shared sim envelope (present in the stub so the safety-veto, telemetry, i18n and colorblind-safe contracts already apply). engine_kind MUST be 'webgl_install'.

scene.description: PLACEHOLDER (expanded in F5/M5): the 3D scene graph — glTF asset R2 keys (Draco-compressed, LOD for mobile), mount points, wire-route targets, terminal blocks, and the verdict-bearing assertions. Also declares the 2D picture-book fallback mapping (same drag targets, same Verdict). Left open here on purpose.

fallback_2d.description: PLACEHOLDER (expanded in M5): reference to the first-class 2D picture-book schematic that produces the SAME Verdict/score as the 3D scene (invariant 7 / F5 §5).
